name: dv_shot_render
description: Render one take of a shot with a model from dv_models_list; modality, task, provider and model name it and are required. Task ref2v renders from reference media through the reference input: imported assets, or versions with reference assets (<id>@<version>, such as c1@1); the prompt cites each reference image as @[<label>](dv:asset/<asset ID>). dv_models_get lists the inputs, media types and counts each model accepts. Task i2v renders from one first_frame image, with no reference or last_frame input. Task l2v renders toward one last_frame image, with no reference or first_frame input. Task fl2v renders between image inputs first_frame and last_frame; both are required, with no reference input. Task v2v regenerates one existing take, passed as its one reference input (<record>#0, the take's video output), with no frame input, such as upscaling a draft to 2K; reuse that take's prompt unchanged. Pass continue_from to start from the last still of an earlier shot when the model takes a first frame. The model's own parameters go in extra (see dv_models_get). A model whose catalog entry reports hosting: managed runs on the provider's servers and uses no local GPU. Outputs: the video, then its last still. Every call is a new take; a changed prompt for the same shot passes based_on. Uses the GPU.

modality.description: The modality of a model that dv_models_list lists.

task.description: The task of that model, as dv_models_list lists it.

provider.description: The provider of that model, as dv_models_list lists it.

model.description: The model name, as dv_models_list lists it.

prompt.description: The complete prompt; follow the prompt skill that dv_models_list names for the model, if any.

worker.description: The exact ID of an enabled worker. Omit for automatic placement. A pinned render never falls back to another worker.

duration_sec.description: Duration in seconds. Use a value the model supports. Defaults to the shortest.

aspect_ratio.description: One of the model aspect ratios; default the first.

resolution.description: One of the model resolutions; default the first.

seed.description: Fixed seed; omitted, a random seed is drawn and recorded.

extra.description: The model's own parameters, as dv_models_get lists them; omit it when the model has none.

continue_from.description: A render record whose last_still (output #1) this shot starts from; only when the model takes a first frame.

reason.description: Why you call this, in the user's words or your own summary; recorded as the intent of the record.

inputs.description: Input references by role: <asset> (an asset ID), <record>#<output> (an output of an earlier record), or <id>@<version> (a character, location or style version; dv_proj_state lists IDs); a list for roles marked []. Roles: reference?: any[] (<asset> or <id>@<version>); first_frame?: image; last_frame?: image.

supersedes.description: Records whose outputs this call replaces, such as an earlier take; their consumers become stale.

based_on.description: The record this call is a changed copy of; the takes of one original share it.
